subject: Implementation transfer — real-time outputs & tool-calls
messages:
From: Anna Soto <anna@integracorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: New feature handoff: streaming outputs + tool-calls

Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Integracorp is excited to move toward a limited rollout of real-time structured outputs and tool-calling for our agent workflows. Before we kickoff, we wanted to clarify two things so our engineering team can prepare: 

1) Expected JSON schema for streaming structured outputs (we need a draft to align validation).
2) How tool-calls will be surfaced in streaming responses (function call markers / fallback semantics).

Could you share a short implementation checklist and propose timing for an onboarding transfer call with your delivery team? We have an internal engineering availability window next week: Mon–Wed afternoons (PST).

Thanks,
Anna Soto
Lead Product Manager — Integracorp
anna@integracorp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Soto <anna@integracorp.com>
Cc: Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 17:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New feature handoff: streaming outputs + tool-calls

Anna —

Appreciate the clear asks. High level plan below; I attached an initial schema draft and a mutual action plan (MAP) for timing. Proposed transfer call: Tue 23 Feb, 1:30pm PST — will that work?

Quick plan (what we'll cover on the transfer call):
- Introductions & success criteria (prod vs. staging)
- Review streaming structured-output schema (integrations + validation hooks)
- Tool-call contract: function signatures, error/fallback behavior, and user-visible markers when streamed
- Security & data flow: keys, redaction, and audit logs for tool calls
- Rollout plan: canary -> bump -> full, plus rollback criteria in MAP
- Task ownership and next steps (tickets, runbook handoff)

Deliverables attached: integracorp_schema_draft_v1.json, mutual_action_plan_RWI-2027-137.xlsx
I cc'ed Connor (implementation lead) and Monica (CS lead) to join the call and own follow-up items.

If Tue 1:30pm PST is not good, propose Wed 2pm as an alternative.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: integracorp_schema_draft_v1.json (application/json) — draft; mutual_action_plan_RWI-2027-137.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 08:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: prep checklist for Integracorp transfer

Team —

Posting the internal prep notes before the transfer call. I'll run the demo for the tool-call behavior; Monica you'll run through MAP items and post-deployment monitoring. Action items I picked up: 

1) Confirm schema versioning policy to call out in the MAP (we'll use semver-like model + model-variant tag).
2) Prepare a short snippet showing streaming partial JSON with function-call markers and a graceful fallback example when a tool is not available. See sample in the schema draft (integracorp_schema_draft_v1.json).
3) Create the validation webhook example and a small test harness repo link to share on the call.

I'll prepare the demo recording for internal review and attach the recording after the call.

—Connor
Staff Software Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Integracorp Onboarding <onboarding@integracorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Anna Soto <anna@integracorp.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 09:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New feature handoff: streaming outputs + tool-calls

Marissa / team —

Tue 23 Feb 1:30pm PST works for us. We'll have Anna (PM), Raj (Eng lead) and Mei (security) on the call. A few asks ahead of time if possible: 
- Can you include a short list of SDK snippets for catching function-call markers during stream parsing (Node + Python)?
- Any recommended latency budget guidance for streaming tool-call use cases?

Thanks — looking forward to the transfer.

—Integracorp Onboarding

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Integracorp Onboarding <onboarding@integracorp.com>, Anna Soto <anna@integracorp.com>
Cc: Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New feature handoff: streaming outputs + tool-calls

Great — confirmed Tue 23 Feb, 1:30pm PST. Call invite sent (Google Meet).

Pre-call deliverables I've attached / linked: 
- integracorp_schema_draft_v1.json — includes examples of streamed partial payloads and a recommended envelope for function-call metadata.
- small demo recording (demo-recording-20270220.mp4) — shows the runtime producing a streaming function call and a fallback path.
- SDK snippets (Node, Python) — included inline in the Drive folder.

Latency guidance (short): for interactive tool-calls we recommend targeting 150–300ms median additional processing per token when using local tool proxies; if the tool is cross-region or cold-starting, add 200–500ms for the tool invocation. We'll review concrete examples on the call and map these to your SLAs.

Call agenda (20–30 min):
- 5m introductions & success criteria
- 8m schema & streaming examples (Connor)
- 7m tool-call contract & SDK parsing snippets (Connor)
- 5m MAP, rollout cadence, and next steps (Monica + Marissa)

See you Tue.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: demo-recording-20270220.mp4 (video), integracorp_schema_draft_v1.json (application/json)
